From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Bridgeline weekly – OKR pulses, QBR prep, and rollout blockers

Team,

Quick read: wins, emerging risks, and asks ahead of next week's QBR. I kept this short — please flag anything that needs to be called out in the deck.

Wins:
- Completed model routing experiment (A/B) — 6% latency improvement for tail calls.
- Dedicated onboarding for Acme POC signed, infra allocation confirmed.
- Internal eval suite run against canary model; no regressions in top-line NPS prompts.

Risks:
1) Rollout blocker: quantized model shows a 2–3% drop on our rerank benchmark at long context (>8k). Impact: could affect Search+Filtering feature in Acme POC. Mitigation: Marissa to lead compensation run with alternate quant profile by Wed 11/25.
2) QBR deck gap: we don't have cost-per-1000-token breakdown for Dedicated vs Hosted at current batch sizes. Impact: Sales/Finance will ask. Ask: Vivek, can you surface the per-route breakdown by EOD 11/23?
3) Procurement timeline: Acme legal requested SOC2 evidence. Impact: may delay contract signature. Ask: Laura, please confirm point contact for shared evidence and ETA.

Asks (owners + due dates):
- Marissa: run quant compensation profiles (deliverable: results table) — due Wed 11/25.
- Vivek: attach cost-per-1000-token slide and supporting numbers — due tonight 11/23 6pm PT.
- Laura: confirm SOC2 evidence package contact and confirm whether we can provide a redacted audit extract — due Thu 11/25.

Attachments: QBR_onepager.pdf (summary slide), okrs_sheet_v3.xlsx (current OKR progress). Linked: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/BRIDGELINE_QBR (internal)

Thanks,
Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
VP, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Bridgeline weekly – OKR pulses, QBR prep, and rollout blockers

Tessa — thanks for the concise note. Two quick clarifications:

- For the rerank benchmark drop, can you paste the failing prompt example (or link to the failing eval id)? I want to see whether it's distributional or an implementation issue.
- On the cost slide ask: do you want per-model or per-customer route numbers? Per-model gives us cleaner comparisons for the deck.

On the deck side, I can take the per-model numbers if Vivek can provide the raw token counts. I'll update the slide once I have both.

Jonas
